segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as deeply hydrating, absorbing quickly and leaving skin feeling nourished rather than dry ([28],[45],[49],[65],[69]).
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, no breakouts and even relief from past reactions to other serums ([27],[32],[47],[56]), but one reviewer with sensitive skin experienced burning and redness ([1]).
segments.mature: Reviewers who identify as mature or in their 60s consistently credit the serum with plumper, firmer skin and fewer visible fine lines, describing it as a long-term staple ([8],[16],[23],[37],[38]).

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers who mention wrinkles or fine lines report visible smoothing, plumping, or reduction after days to weeks of use ([13],[15],[19],[22],[38],[41],[53],[72],[78]); one reviewer says the effect is only temporary and lines return once the product is washed off ([15]).
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe strong hydration and a plumped, dewy feel, often calling it a 'drink of water' for the skin ([28],[34],[48],[60],[70]); no negative reports on hydration appear.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product reduced redness alongside spots ([75]); another with sensitive skin reports the opposite, that it caused her face to burn and turn red ([1]).
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers imply improved barrier comfort, describing the serum as soothing and non-irritating even on reactive skin ([32],[56]); no explicit barrier-damage complaints are present besides the burning reaction noted elsewhere.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports improvement in skin tone and reduced spots ([75]); this is the only explicit mention of spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts say the product does not cause them, including one who states it is the only skincare that doesn't trigger breakouts ([52],[56]); one reviewer with unspecified skin reports the product caused breakouts and returned it ([0]).
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the serum balances skin without making it oily or dry, describing it as 'not oily, not dry' ([12]); no other oiliness complaints or praise recur.
